title: Record an architecture decision
summary: Records one durable architecture decision as a proposed immutable entry with exact alternatives, consequences, and supersession semantics.

replacements.reason: Existing decision records remain immutable history without becoming mandatory development ceremony.
limitations: Historical decision numbering and indexes grant no runtime or promotion authority.

replacements.reason: Development results may reference exact optional decision evidence when a durable rationale is useful.
limitations: No ADR is generated or required automatically.

intent.goal: Preserve the rationale for one genuinely constraining choice without turning task notes, status, or incidental implementation details into permanent law.
useWhen: A confirmed choice among real alternatives constrains future architecture or operation.
excludeWhen: The material is status, a task, transient context, or an unconfirmed decision produced by implementation work.

procedure.outcome: Confirm the choice has real alternatives, durable consequences, and explicit user-owned decision content.

safeguards: Never rewrite accepted decision content; use an explicit superseding record.
Never infer acceptance from permission to perform adjacent implementation work.
Never create a decision record for status, notes, or information without a real choice.
limitations: This normalized definition preserves inspectable intent only; it has no operator runtime, provider binding, effect authority, or behavior parity.
The fingerprinted legacy source remains canonical until a separate implemented and evidenced runtime migration removes that fallback.
